info.name: ItsaCheckmate Marketplace for Developers Locations OAuth API

items.docs: Issues an access token and refresh token using the authorization_code grant (initial issuance) or the refresh_token grant (renewal). Access tokens expire in 24 hours by default. Tokens are scoped; the menus scope is required to call the Get Menu endpoint.
Returns information about the current access token, including expiration and granted scopes, so a partner can determine when to refresh credentials before the token expires.
